_comment: Corpus-grounded wordlist for brand-token collision detection (B2 Batch G). At data-load time every brand token is checked against this list at its configured edit distance. Tokens that collide are forced to exact-match only to prevent spurious fuzzy alerts. Tokens that ARE themselves in this list also require a context-token hit even for exact matching. Source: B2 B3 FP analysis of 60k unfiltered negatives.
